home.title: Afio mai i {{app}}
home.tagline: O se nuu e tasi mo le toe foi i le aiga ma tumau ai le soifua maloloina.

area.comingSoon: O le a oo mai. O lenei vaega e le tumau i le taimi nei.

wellbeing.checkinTitle: O a mai oe i le aso?
wellbeing.loginNeeded: Ulufale e sefe ai le check-in.
wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.suggestFilters: O filifiliga ua fautuaina mo le aso
wellbeing.locksHelp: E mafai ona e lokaina se vaega mo se vaiaso, lua vaiaso, se masina pe faavavau. O le faamau o faalavelave, fesoasoani mo le toe foi, fesootaiga saogalemu ma le tapeina o faamatalaga e le lokaina lava.
wellbeing.addLock: Faaopoopo se loka o le vaiaso

community.anonymous: Lafo e aunoa ma le igoa
community.noPhone: E le faaali lava numera o telefoni i feau i le va.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Fonotaga e sefulu ma le lua laasaga ma le toe malosi

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Taofi lau sponsor po o se fesootaiga saogalemu ia te oe.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: O le mea moni lea e tape ai lau faamatalaga, e le toe foi mai.
safety.wipeConfirm: Ua ou malamalama o le mea lea e tape moni ai la'u faamatalaga.

reentry.checklistTitle: Lisi siaki o le toe foi
reentry.noSteps: E lei oo mai laasaga o le lisi.
reentry.tipsTitle: Fautuaga mai ia i latou na faia
reentry.tipsAnonymous: E aunoa ma igoa fautuaga. E le faaali lava numera o telefoni.
reentry.addTip: Faasoa se fautuaga e aunoa ma le igoa
reentry.tipPlaceholder: O le a le mea na fesoasoani ia te oe i lenei laasaga?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Ua uma le laasaga muamua — afio mai i le aiga.
reentry.celebrationAll: Ua uma laasaga e 33. Faamanatu lou alualu i luma.
reentry.crisisStep: Sefe ia numera nei. E mafai foi ona e oomiina le "Need help now" i luga o soo se lau.
reentry.resourceOnly: Na o le taiala o punaoa — e le tuuina mai e Groundwork lenei ma e le paaga ma se tasi.

steps.step3: Amata le talosaga mo le ID o le setete
steps.step4: Faatulaga ni sini ma lau pule o mataupu
steps.step5: Fuafua lou toe foi i le aiga
steps.step6: Sauni se fesootaiga e tasi e fesoasoani
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Siaki pepa o le tatalaina ma aso e gata ai
steps.step10: Faamaonia le aso ma tuutuuga o le check-in muamua
steps.step12: Aumai lau ID o le setete
steps.step13: Aumai telefoni, imeli ma initaneti e leai se totogi
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Fesootai i auaunaga o le toe foi i le lotoifale
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Siaki le tulaga o le laisene ave taavale
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step20: Aumai faamaumauga o lou soifua maloloina
steps.step22: Tusi se taimi ma le fomai
steps.step23: Tusi se taimi mo le soifua maloloina o le mafaufau
steps.step24: Fai se iloiloga o le faaaogaina o fualaau
steps.step27: Tusi talosaga i tagata faigaluega e tuuina atu avanoa faalua
steps.step28: Aoao e uiga i aoaoga po o tusi pasi
steps.step29: Tatala se teugatupe ma fai se paketi
steps.step30: Amata ona toe fausia lau aitalafu
steps.step31: Toe faatasia ma le aiga, faasa'o le tausiga o fanau pe a manaomia
steps.step32: Fai se masani i aso taitasi
steps.step33: Faatulaga se sini mamao ma faamanatu ou aso e 90

work.jobsTitle: Galuega e tuuina atu avanoa faalua
work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: E patino lava. Faasoa pe a e filifilia.

venue.placeholder: Nofoaga le tumau — potu pusa lanu efuefu. E leai ni ata moni o le nofoaga; e le o le nofoaga moni lea.

family.help: E na o le aiga e vaai i le mea e te filifilia e faasoa.
family.defaultsOff: O faasoa taitasi e pe lava.

readAloud.title: Faitau leotele
readAloud.help: O le faitau leotele e faaaoga le leo o lau masini e faitau ai tusitusiga.

phase3.resumeHelp: Fai se resume faigofie mai lou tomai.
phase3.headline: Ulutala
phase3.interviewHelp: Faataitai tali. E avatu e lou faiaoga ni togi ma se fautuaga.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.mentorshipHelp: Saili se faufautua pe avea ma faufautua.
phase3.geoHelp: E na o lou aai e vaai i ai isi. E le faasoa lava le nofoaga sao.
phase3.rideHelp: Talosaga se taavale. E le faaali lava numera o telefoni. Feiloai i se nofoaga lautele.
phase3.partnersHelp: Vaega laiti e taatolu e vaai le tasi i le isi.
phase3.meetingsTitle: Fonotaga i luga o le initaneti
phase3.caption: Faamatalaga o le ata
phase3.qaTitle: Fesili ma tali e aunoa ma le igoa
phase3.qaHelp: Fesili e aunoa ma le igoa. E tali mai sui ua agai i luma.
phase3.ask: Fesili e aunoa ma le igoa
phase3.merchHelp: Na o faailoga e iai code. E leai se mea i fafo e faamatalaina ai o latou uiga, e leai ni aso e lolomi.
phase3.shareTitle: Pepa o le alualu i luma
phase3.shareHelp: Se pepa e iai numera o lou alualu i luma.
phase3.archiveHelp: Faamau se feau mo oe. E tatala i le aso taua.
phase3.matchHelp: O lau sui e muamua talanoa ma isi sui. Ua pe le feiloaiga i le taimi nei. E mafai ona e iloa pe aisea, talosaga se folasaga ma toe taumafai.
phase3.interests: Mea e fiafia i ai (tuuese i koma)
phase3.datingOff: Ua pe le feiloaiga seia oo ina faatulaga le tulafono o aso itiiti.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Vaai muamua iinei. Faitalia, tulaga o le aai lava: vaai po o ai e alu i lau fonotaga ma fesootai e ala i feau o le app. Leai se telefoni, leai se nofoaga sao.
phase3.groupsTitle2: Taiala o vaega o le nuu
phase3.groupsHelp: Vaega o le toe malosi, fesoasoani mo le toe foi, faatuatua ma le nuu e tusa ma le aai ma le taimi o le fonotaga. Na o faamatalaga faataitai — e le o se lisi moni.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: E na o faaali pe a leai se tasi i luga o le laupapa e alu i lau fonotaga. E lafo se talosaga e vaavaaia i le app — tulaga o le aai lava, leai se telefoni.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: E leai se taavale faatasi e fetaui mo lenei fonotaga, o lea ua faaali Manaomia se taavale e fai ma faaleoleo.
phase3.familyRideTitle: Fesootaiga o taavale a le aiga
phase3.familyRideHelp: Na o ave taavale ua faamaonia. E auina taitasi feau ma le faatali e 2 minute; e te faamaonia a o lei oo i le isi.
phase3.approveContact: Faailoga e fai ma ave taavale ua faamaonia
phase3.pingStart: Auina atu le ave taavale muamua
phase3.pingNext: Auina atu le isi ave taavale
phase3.pingConfirm: Faamaonia a o lei oo i le isi
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.goalSaved: Ua teu e oo mai i le taimi nei ($)
phase3.calcResult: masina seia oo i lau sini
phase3.planTitle: Fuafuaga mo le sauniuni o le fale
phase3.musicHelp: Na o pese faataitai. Leai ni teugatupe e tafe ai. E pe le ta i totonu o vasega o le aoga.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Ua pe le musika a o e i totonu o le vasega.
phase3.portfolioVisibility: O ai e mafai ona vaai i lenei
phase3.visLink: Sooga (e le mateia, e mafai ona aveese)
phase3.shareWho: Nei: na o oe. O le faia o se sooga e mafai ai soo se tasi e iai le sooga ona faitau.
phase3.suggestTitle: Na fautuaina mai ou mea taua
phase3.suggestHelp: Na o fautuaga — e leai se mea e lolomi seia e faaopoopoina.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Na o oe e mafai ona vaai i lenei feau.
crisisReply.openCrisis: Tatala le faamau o faalavelave ma fesootaiga saogalemu
